summary: Bush-backed kerb at the end of the gravel apron, narrowing toward the bridge.
reasons: Room to stop only near the gravel apron
Steep fall to the creek past 25 m

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind the kerb; nearest dwelling 29 m up the slope; canoe club 44 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel apron adjoins the start; beyond it the road narrows to the bridge with trees at the edge, so room beside the lane is tight.
drivers.traffic: Through road to the bridge; cars park on the road here in both images.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P Angle; a car is parked at the kerb in both images.

flags: Steep: about 4% on the best section, over 13% mean along the whole line
Low-lying: elevation falls to 2.5 m, Witton Creek 2 m away, flood-prone
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the kerb from the north and east; open to the afternoon sun from the south-west.
cannot_judge: Whether the apron's end gives full width off the lane

best_section.where: North side of Witton Road at the east end of the gravel apron, before the creek bridge
